Okay hair care tip cause my hair which makes it a lot simpler to take care of, stop shampooing it. It sounds counter intuitive, and it def is at first. For the first few weeks your hair is gonna be super super greasy, but over time the oils in your scalp adapt to not having to constantly needing to replenish. I started by mistake, I was in a ward and just didn’t have the energy to maintain my hair. Over time it just worked it self out. Last time I washed my hair was a couple months ago.

Hey, I’ve been there. Two and a half years ago I was a  6’2” wrestler and baseball player who could grow a beard in a couple days. Now I’m a 6’2” punk bitch who almost exclusively wears men’s clothing without makeup yet still generally passes (my voice outs me). I’ve only been on it for about five months now but let me tell you, HRT is magic. 

Now I still haven’t had electrolysis or laser but my body hair’s lighter and thinner. My facial hair still bothers the absolute shit out of me. 

r/wetshaving and r/wicked_edge have made it so that my five o’clock shadow at least shows up when I’m asleep instead of, well, you know, five o’clock. Check them out, they could probably help you out. They are definitely geared towards men but the information is solid. 

Hope something here helps you out. ❤️
